about.how.heading: How it works
about.how.body: We read the centres' websites several times a day. Always check the centre's page before you register.

about.not_checked.intro: We don't check a centre automatically when:

about.not_checked.reason_opted_out: the centre asked us not to check it
about.not_checked.reason_failed: our last check of their site failed
about.not_checked.none: Every centre is checked automatically right now.
about.not_checked.error: We couldn't load the list of centres.
about.no_location.heading: Centres we can't place on the map
about.no_location.intro: We don't know where these centres are yet, so they only appear when you search their town or postcode.

about.sources.heading: Sources
about.sources.directory: The list of approved test centres in Bavaria. It is based on the BAMF list and taken from rtpartner.de until BAMF sends us its own list.
about.attribution.heading: Attribution
about.opt_out.heading: For test centres
about.opt_out.body: If you run a test centre and do not want us to check your website, you can ask us to stop.
